durationScope: From reproduction startup through stack cleanup, including image checks and media rendering; final report writing excluded.

environment.video: Original visitor-guide video; silent VP9 WebM; recipe: tools/make-video.sh

conditions.network: Isolated Docker bridge; no external media requests
conditions.cache: New browser contexts for each state and viewport
conditions.URLNormalization: Container origin replaced by public local URL in browser evidence; request paths and errors unchanged.

outcomes.before: Blocked by media-src CSP; zero decoded frames and zero time progress
outcomes.after: Decoded frames and time progress, seek to 5 seconds, completion at 8 seconds
outcomes.cleanup: run.sh removes stack and volumes on exit
